BR elements in table cells render as line breaks

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<table><tr><th>Header</th></tr><tr><td>Line 1<br>Line 2</td></tr></table>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(br_in_tables: true))
puts result.content.inspect
```
